request.summary: Stop sending a screenshot for clan coffer Discord alerts - post text-only (the existing chat-message text already names the acting player), while loot and death alerts keep sending screenshots unchanged.
request.raw_requirements:
Tweak the clan coffer Discord alert (added in the already-shipped discord-loot-death-coffer-alerts task, archived at .mflow/tasks/archive/2026/discord-loot-death-coffer-alerts/) to stop sending a screenshot - post text only.

Current behavior (src/main/java/com/catastrophic/events/alerts/CofferAlertListener.java): on a clan coffer deposit/withdraw chat message, it captures a screenshot via ScreenshotCapture and sends both the screenshot and the raw chat message text (which already names the depositing/withdrawing player, e.g. "Zezima has deposited 500,000 coins into the coffer.") to catabot's POST /alerts endpoint via AlertsApiClient.

Requested change: drop the screenshot entirely for coffer alerts - post only the text summary (which already contains the acting player's name from the raw in-game chat message). Loot and death alerts are unaffected and keep sending screenshots.

This requires a plugin-side change (AlertsApiClient needs a way to send an alert with no image; CofferAlertListener stops calling ScreenshotCapture) and a companion catabot-side change (POST /alerts currently requires an image file for every kind - see src/http/server.ts - needs to make the image optional, at least for kind=coffer, and only attach a files array to the Discord message when an image is present). The catabot side also currently prefixes the message with "**RSN**" looked up from the reporting client's own linked Discord account (Member.primaryRsn via req.discordId) - decided during this intake: drop that prefix for coffer specifically (it names the observing client, not the actual depositor, and coffer messages broadcast clan-wide so the observer isn't necessarily the actor), while loot and death keep the RSN prefix unchanged since those describe the reporting player's own action.

This plugin-repo task covers the plugin-side change only; the catabot-side change will be tracked as a separate companion task in that repo's own .mflow, same pattern as the original feature.

plan.approach: Add a no-image overload to AlertsApiClient.sendAlert(...), keeping the existing image-carrying overload for loot/death unchanged, sharing the request-building/response-handling logic between both rather than duplicating it. Update CofferAlertListener to call the new overload directly instead of routing through ScreenshotCapture, dropping that dependency entirely from the class.
steps: Step 1 - api/AlertsApiClient.java: add sendAlert(String token, AlertKind kind, String summary, ApiCallback<Void> callback) (no pngBytes param). Refactor both overloads to share one private request-building/response-handling path, parameterized on an optional image part, instead of duplicating the OkHttp Callback anonymous class a second time (watch WRN-005 - don't add a third copy of the 401/unsuccessful/network classification).
Step 2 - alerts/CofferAlertListener.java: remove the ScreenshotCapture field and constructor param entirely; call the new no-image sendAlert(...) overload directly with the matched chat message text.

Step 3 - README.md: update the "Discord alerts" section's coffer bullet to note it's text-only (no screenshot), and mention the catabot-side companion change (making image optional on POST /alerts for kind=coffer, dropping the misleading RSN prefix for coffer) is tracked separately in that repo's own .mflow.

Step 4 - Manual QA: ./gradlew compileJava to confirm it compiles clean. No live game session available in this environment - full in-game confirmation (coffer alert posts text-only, loot/death alerts unaffected) is on the developer before shipping.

verification.notes: Definition of done confirmed by developer (all 4 plan steps complete, conventions followed, no unit tests since no test framework exists in this repo - TD-001, no staging branch in use here). Concerns check: no new concerns - WRN-005 not made worse, and the catabot-side dependency (image optional for coffer, no RSN prefix for coffer) is confirmed resolved and live on catabot's origin/main. Dev UAT checklist (5 items covering text-only posting, correct actor attribution, loot/death regression, and coffer dedup) confirmed passing by developer.
